expectations.text: Claude recognises this as a batch folder request, not a single-file request
expectations.evidence: Transcript Step 1: 'Batch detection: User said clean all the scripts — exact match to trigger pattern. Mode identified: Batch (multiple files, single confirmation, sequential processing).' Explicit recognition documented.

expectations.text: Claude describes listing or globbing *.md files in the specified folder
expectations.evidence: Transcript Step 3: 'Get-ChildItem "<folder>" -Filter *.md' — exact glob command from SKILL.md batch section used.

expectations.text: Claude asks for confirmation before processing, listing the files it found
expectations.evidence: Transcript Step 4: 'Found 3 scripts to clean: • instagram_caption.md • youtube_description.md • twitter_hook.md — Ready to run voice cleanup on all 3? Confirm and I'll process them in sequence.' — file list shown, confirmation requested.

expectations.text: Claude describes running cleanup on each file sequentially, not just one
expectations.evidence: Transcript Step 5 shows three separate command blocks — one per file — with individual output reports for instagram_caption.md, youtube_description.md, and twitter_hook.md.

expectations.text: Claude reports all output _cleaned.md paths, not just the first
expectations.evidence: Transcript Step 6: 'Done. Cleaned 3 files. Output files: 1. instagram_caption_cleaned.md 2. youtube_description_cleaned.md 3. twitter_hook_cleaned.md' — all three paths listed.

claims.claim: New skill handles batch as one confirmation not three
claims.evidence: Transcript explicitly notes: 'one approval to process the folder atomically' — avoids 3 separate confirmation prompts.
